annotations.annotation: The pie chart represents the distribution of various categories related to a specific data set. It consists of six slices. The "chat" category is labeled in red and constitutes 41.2% of the chart. The "math" category is shown in blue, making up 21.9%. The "tooluse" category is in green, representing 11.6%. In orange, the "multi turn chat" category accounts for 9.3%. The "code" category is in purple with a proportion of 9.0%. Lastly, the "instruction follow" category, in pink, comprises 6.9% of the chart. The chart includes a legend in the upper left corner with corresponding colors for each category, and percentage labels are placed outside the slices. The segments appear to be ordered by ascending order of size starting from the "instruction follow segment" in clockwise fashion, and there is no visual emphasis through explosion or offsetting of the slices.
